SELECT
  t.ticket_id,
  t.email,
  t.subject,
  t.message,
  t.categoria,
  t.sentimiento,
  t.complejidad,
  t.lenguaje_agresivo,
  t.estado,
  TO_CHAR(t.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH12:MI AM') AS received_at,
  TO_CHAR(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH12:MI AM') AS created_at,
  TO_CHAR(t.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH12:MI AM') AS updated_at,
  (
    SELECT json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'estado', h.estado,
        'accion', h.accion,
        'fecha', TO_CHAR(h.fecha AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH12:MI AM')
      ) ORDER BY h.fecha ASC
    )
    FROM ticket_historial h
    WHERE h.ticket_id = t.ticket_id
  ) AS historial
FROM tickets t
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'Recibido') AS recibidos,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'Escalado a humano') AS escalados,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'Resuelto automáticamente') AS resueltos_auto,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'Cerrado por humano') AS cerrados_humano,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'CRITICA') AS criticos,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'SIMPLE') AS simples,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS ultimos_7_dias
FROM tickets;
